case.pattern_description: Shared-device fraud ring: one device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) behind an anonymising proxy is used to make small online purchases on 28 unrelated customers' cards in the same weeks, each time appearing as a New device for that account. It affects many customers at once rather than one compromised card; the agent found it by traversing card -> transaction -> device -> card in TigerGraph and matching the profile to earlier confirmed undocumented cases.

sar.narrative: Customer C02910, holder of card C02910-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-18 18:17 and 2016-12-04 11:17, 3 transaction(s) totalling $531.39 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $224.80 (3468314, 2016-11-18 18:17), $101.70 (3485910, 2016-11-25 12:37), $204.89 (3512532, 2016-12-04 11:17). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.492; Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-3035. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
